name: Vigor Roundedge
description: Circle both wrists in mirrored loops with a ring on each until the joints move as one.

name: Benevolent Bladering
description: Sight along the rim like a hawk judging a drop and fix the line before either ring leaves.

name: Heroic Fingerhole
description: Pitch both rings low and fast so they cross just above the target's knees.

name: Bouncedecree
description: Throw each ring in a long crescent so the two arcs meet in front of the target.

name: Dantian Hoopedge
description: Sweep both rims outward like a hawk's wings to knock a spear shaft off its line.

name: Quenched Gyrate
description: Step in and cut with both rims at once so the foe's guard splits two ways.

name: Splendid Disk
description: Cross both rings in flight at the last instant so their edges meet through one point of the guard.

name: Marrowfire Holeedge
description: Cast both rings in opposing crescents so they cross behind a foe and snare his arms.

name: Thunderclap Ringface
description: Shoot past the foe's guard in a streak and cut both flanks with the paired rims as you cross.

name: Majestic Whirlcut
description: Loose both rings in wide opposed crescents that meet and sweep a crowded front as the school's closing lesson.

name: Tranquil Roundedge
description: Grip each ring as smooth as a river stone with the thumb along the rim and fingers loose.

name: Dantian Holeedge
description: Skim two rings level over the ground a rim's width apart toward one target.

name: Feather Ricochet
description: Shift the weight from bank to bank of the stance in a slow even pace.

name: Gyratebanner
description: Throw the pair so they split around the foe's guard like a current round a post.

name: Undefiled Disk
description: Spin the rim in a small eddy to draw a blade round and off its mark.

name: Marrowfire Outerblade
description: Cross the foe's front in two quick steps while the rim cuts low across the thigh.

name: Volition Bladering
description: Pour pair after pair of rings at one spot like spring water until the foe gives way.

name: Noble Graze
description: Send a ring around a bend of cover so it cuts the foe on its way back to the hand.

name: Carom Vow
description: Spin both rings in a tightening ring about a foe so he cannot plant a foot to strike.

name: Magmabounce
description: Spread both rings wide over a broad low field so they sweep every foe standing on it.

name: Caromtriumph
description: Lead the foe's eye along the stream with one ring while the second loosed late arrives from the bank and ends the exchange.

name: Parity Hoopedge
description: Rise from a low court posture to full height with both rings already turning.

name: Peal Ringface
description: Pitch the left ring along one track and the right along another toward the same mark.

name: Vigor Graze
description: Turn on the heel without a scuff so the foe does not hear the hips come round.

name: Gyratevow
description: Show a throw with one hand and loose the other so the foe commits to the wrong guard.

name: Venerable Innergrip
description: Whirl one ring before each side of the body on two tracks that cover every high line.

name: Pulsarround
description: Bank one ring off a corner while the second flies straight so the foe is struck from two sides.

name: Steelcarom
description: Drive both spinning rims into the foe's guard at one point and judge it breached.

name: Snaring Fingerhole
description: Leave two rings turning across the foe's two likely paths so either step meets a rim.

name: Inferno Outerblade
description: Sweep both rims out at a great pitch so they cut across the whole width of a hall.

name: Grand Carom
description: Hold a foe within the crossing tracks of two rings and close them in a chain of cuts as the school's final form.

name: Gracious Innergrip
description: Stretch both arms wide like a hawk's wings with a ring on each hand to open the shoulders.

name: Luminous Disk
description: Count the turns of each ring against the other until the two spins fall in step.

name: Prismgyrate
description: Slide both rings from open palms in a single flat skim along the same line.

name: Inviolate Bladering
description: Sink wide and low with both arms forward so the rings guard the front like a basin's rim.

name: Peerless Carom
description: Drop both rings from above the head so they stoop together on the foe's shoulders.

name: Inferno Bounce
description: Throw a ring that rebounds off the ground and strikes the foe a second time as it comes back.

name: Undaunted Ringface
description: Cross both rims in an X before the face and turn a downward cut to the side.

name: Squallbounce
description: Slip along the lip of the foe's reach and cut across the wrist as you pass.

name: Valiant Gyrate
description: Leap and dive on the foe with both rims leading so their edges drive through the crown of the guard.

name: Steadfast Roundedge
description: Hold both rings in slow orbits close about the body so the whole front is covered.

name: Fingerhole Verdict
description: Run both rings through the full circuit of the art so they cut outward while covering the thrower.

name: Destiny Spinrim
description: Stoop with one ring and return with the other from the basin so the foe is struck from above and below.

name: Bloom Holeedge
description: Seat each ring on its fingertip so the two orbits turn in opposite senses without touching.

name: Pulsarcarom
description: Pitch the pair level and a hand apart so they ride the same height to the mark.

name: Evanescent Spinrim
description: Slide one pace on the out-breath while both rings keep their even turn.

name: Grazeverdict
description: Fling an orbiting ring from the fingertip so it carries its whole spin onto the foe.

name: Sphere Innergrip
description: Meet a cut with one orbiting rim and let the other fly out in answer.

name: Haemal Hoopedge
description: Draw both orbits in together across the foe's body in one scissoring slice.

name: Penumbra Spinrim
description: Cast one orbit around the foe and the other across it so the rims tether his limbs.

name: Steeldisk
description: Drive both orbits to a single point so the combined spin bores through a heavy guard.

name: Pulsargyrate
description: Fold the distance in one burst and strike from the foe's blind side with both rims.

name: Splendid Ricochet
description: Raise both orbits to crown the sky above a field of foes and bring their edges down across it together.

name: Vigor Innergrip
description: Breathe the Core's steady rhythm into the arms until each ring settles upright like a wheel.

name: Clement Outerblade
description: Fix the gaze on the line where the sky meets the target and let both rings follow it.

name: Kernelcarom
description: Pitch both rings upright so they roll through the air like a pair of wheels.

name: Matchless Whirlcut
description: Skim an upright ring in a long arc that rises over the guard and drops behind it.

name: Fingerhole Vow
description: Break a descending cut with the rim of one wheel and send the other past the opening.

name: Gyrateverdict
description: Roll an upright ring up the foe's forearm so its rim cuts the whole length of it.

name: Nucleus Whirlcut
description: Throw both wheels so their paths cross like spokes and strike at the very centre.

name: Exalted Ricochet
description: Drive both qi-charged wheels into one spot to rend armor and what lies beneath it.

name: Outerblade Pledge
description: Hold both wheels turning at the flanks so projectiles strike a rim and glance back toward their source.

name: Nucleus Gyrate
description: Release both wheels at the full reach of the arms so they roll over a wide front.

name: Fearless Graze
description: Send twin wheels over an open field so they roll through every line standing in their path.

name: Serene Spinrim
description: Close the grip around the rim as an oath is closed and let the wind tug at it in vain.

name: Vaunted Carom
description: Throw level across flat open ground so the ring runs far without rising or falling.

name: Feather Gyrate
description: Step along a narrow bare ridge with the ring arm out for balance against the gusts.

name: Pealgraze
description: Cast into a gust so the ring bends away from the foe and back into him.

name: Bladering Seal
description: Take a blow on the sworn rim and turn its force away with the wind's help.

name: Pealgyrate
description: Hurl the ring along a ridge's edge so the drop beside it keeps the foe from stepping aside.

name: Pealdisk
description: Wind up with the whole body and throw into the full gale so the ring flies faster than the throw alone.

name: Unwavering Holeedge
description: Spin the ring against the gust at the flank so blows meet the whirling rim and are turned.

name: Spectral Hoopedge
description: Burst forward on a gust and cut the foe in passing before he can raise a guard.

name: Valiant Whirlcut
description: Throw the ring across the open plateau on the wind so it sweeps wide and cuts every foe on its bearing.

name: Reminiscence Innergrip
description: Speak the bearing aloud before the throw so the eye and the arm are sworn to one line.

name: Royal Roundedge
description: Turn the rim to the sworn bearing at the moment of release and let it fly true.

name: Wraithlike Hoopedge
description: Pivot on the sworn foot to face a new bearing without moving the other.

name: Carom Crown
description: Skim the ring along a bearing held unchanged until it strikes low at the mark.

name: Sainted Disk
description: Break a blade's line by changing your own bearing a hand's breadth as it falls.

name: Roundedge Decree
description: Throw out on one bearing and bring the ring back on its reverse so it cuts twice.

name: Haemalhoop
description: Step along the sworn line and draw the rim across the foe in one unbroken cut.

name: Triumphant Graze
description: Hold one bearing through the whole throw so the ring's edge drives straight through the guard.

name: Dantian Fingerhole
description: Leave a ring spinning on a sworn line so any foe who crosses it meets the edge.

name: Grazebanner
description: Cast along a held bearing at a foe beyond the range of sight and let the ring find him.

name: Grand Ricochet
description: Hold a single bearing through a chain of throws and cuts so each follows the last along the same line.

name: Vigor Outerblade
description: Seat the ring upright in the palm and pledge its spin before the first throw.

name: Bountiful Spinrim
description: Hold the ring into the wind and let the gust spin it up on the fingertip.

name: Disktriumph
description: Pitch from the hand turned to the wind so the gust adds its push to the release.

name: Radiance Bounce
description: Send the upright ring in a high arc so it rolls down onto the foe from above.

name: Unyielding Bladering
description: Catch a thrown blade on the turning rim and hold it still against the wind.

name: Bouncetriumph
description: Cut with the ring held like a wheel's spoke and let the gust drive it through the stroke.

name: Noble Ringface
description: Roll the ring off a guard and let the gale turn it back to strike the same foe again.

name: Sacrosanct Disk
description: Hold the wheel turning at the chest against the gale so every blow meets a living rim.

name: Duneround
description: Cast the upright ring into a rising gale so it rolls across the whole slope of open ground.

name: Seasongyrate
description: Cast the wheel out on the oath and catch its return in a cut so the gale carries the whole chain.

name: Consecrated Innergrip
description: Stand square with an open side to every quarter and the ring guard ready to turn to any.

name: Grazetriumph
description: Pitch the ring across wide plain ground where nothing in the way will turn it.

name: Revelation Hoopedge
description: Check that the wrist cuff is snug against the wind before any throw is made.

name: Squall Graze
description: Pace in the open without ever crouching behind a thing and keep the ring hand high.

name: Squallgyrate
description: Throw from the open side so the ring bends in against the foe's covered flank.

name: Vaunted Ringface
description: Fan several rings into a clustered knot of foes so none can stand in the open.

name: Pall Disk
description: Slip the blade past on a turn of the ring and ride the gust out of reach.

name: Vigor Ricochet
description: Run into the wind and scoop the spent ring from the grass without breaking pace.

name: Consecrated Holeedge
description: Whirl rings in all directions about the body so a blow from any side finds a turning rim.

name: Thunderclap Carom
description: Drive the ring straight across open ground in a single hard throw that punches through a braced front.

name: Solarbounce
description: Throw into the full plateau gale so the ring sweeps over the whole open front.

name: Grand Fingerhole
description: Meet foes on all sides in the open with a chain of rim throws and guards that leaves none unanswered.

name: Luminous Holeedge
description: Spin the ring slowly on the fingertip until the rim runs steady and its edge feels warm.

name: Spherehoop
description: Pitch with the plateau wind at the side so the ring leaves already leaning into its line.

name: Vigor Gyrate
description: Pivot on the heel as a gust strikes and let it turn the hips for the next throw.

name: Sovereign Bounce
description: Lob the ring edge up so it turns over at the top and drops flat on the target.

name: Sacrosanct Ringface
description: Part an incoming spear and its wind with a turned rim and step through the gap.

name: Gyratedecree
description: Cut in a rising spiral with the wind behind the ring so the stroke climbs the foe's body.

name: Radiance Spinrim
description: Throw with the plateau's wind full behind the rim so it punches deep through a hardened guard.

name: Cunning Spinrim
description: Set several rings turning in a line across a path where the wind keeps them spinning for the foe.

name: Diskboon
description: Dash along the edge of a gale in one burst and cut the foe's guard arm as you pass.

name: Noble Bladering
description: Gather the winds of the high plateau into one turning edge that sweeps across a crowded front.

name: Bladering Blessing
description: Breathe in time with a rising gale until the Core's pulse and the wind keep one pace.

name: Interstice Innergrip
description: Sight through the ring's open centre at the sworn mark and hold it there.

name: Prism Graze
description: Pitch with the whole body steadied on the Core so the ring leaves without a wobble.

name: Pulsar Whirlcut
description: Skim the ring over open ground on the gale so it holds its height across a long run.

name: Enshrined Outerblade
description: Meet a heavy cut on the broad rim and turn its weight into the ground.

name: Imperial Whirlcut
description: Cut in a wide level sweep with the gale behind the stroke so it carries through a guard.

name: Squallcarom
description: Step through on the oath and loose the ring in a great arc across the foe's front.

name: Thunderclap Ricochet
description: Throw the great ring with Core-driven qi so it rends a heavy shield and what it covers.

name: Undefiled Holeedge
description: Keep the great ring orbiting the body in the gale so it takes whatever strikes toward the thrower.

name: Kernelbounce
description: Cast the ring into the full gale so its sweeping flight carries across the whole plateau front.

name: Triumphant Bounce
description: Raise the great ring in a standing gale and cast it so its sweep cuts everything on the open plateau.
